/**
 * Alerting pg-boss queue wiring (enterprise).
 *
 * Job types:
 *   - alert.form-batches        — claim pending events into batches of 100, enqueue
 *   - alert.process-batch       — process one batch (localConcurrency, dead-lettered)
 *   - alert.escalation-sweep    — advance due escalations + resume expired acks
 *   - alert.auto-resolve        — auto-resolve stale firing alerts
 *   - alert.orphan-sweep        — requeue events/batches stuck in 'processing'
 *   - alert.cleanup             — retention purge (scheduled daily)
 *   - alert.dead-letter-retry   — re-drive retryable dead letters (scheduled)
 *   - alert-dead-letter         — pg-boss dead-letter queue for process-batch
 *
 * Concurrency guarantees:
 *   - pg-boss fetches jobs with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED internally, so two
 *     workers never receive the same job.
 *   - Every DB-side claim (pending events, escalations, expired acks, stuck
 *     processing, dead letters) uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED too.
 *   - Scheduled jobs use singletonKey so multiple worker processes never
 *     double-run a schedule.
 *
 * Failure model:
 *   - process-batch jobs retry 3× with backoff, then land in
 *     `alert-dead-letter`, which is persisted to `alert_dead_letter_events`.
 *   - The orphan sweeper requeues their events back to 'pending' (automatic
 *     recovery); operators can additionally re-drive or discard dead letters
 *     via the admin API.
 *
 * Registration runs in the WORKER process (see workers/main.ts), where pg-boss
 * is started. The API process stays thin and only inserts pending events.
 */
import type { FastifyBaseLogger } from 'fastify';
import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import { pgboss } from '../../lib/pgboss.js';
import { env } from '../../config/env.js';
import { pool } from '../../config/database.js';
import { AlertingRepository } from './repository.js';
import { AlertBatchProcessor, type BatchJobData } from './batch-processor.js';
import { AlertEscalationSweep } from './escalation.js';
import { ConnectorRepository } from '../connectors/repository.js';
import type { ProjectSubscriptionResolver } from './batch-processor.js';
import { AlertRuntimeEngines, type FastEvaluationInput } from './runtime/engines.js';
import { AlertNotificationRouter } from './runtime/notification-router.js';
import { TelemetryOutboxRelay } from './runtime/telemetry-outbox-relay.js';
import { AlertDecisionEngine, type AlertDecisionCandidate } from './decision/decision.engine.js';
import { SnapshotEscalationWorker } from './escalation/escalation.worker.js';

export const ALERT_JOBS = {
  formBatches: 'alert.form-batches',
  processBatch: 'alert.process-batch',
  escalationSweep: 'alert.escalation-sweep',
  autoResolve: 'alert.auto-resolve',
  orphanSweep: 'alert.orphan-sweep',
  cleanup: 'alert.cleanup',
  deadLetter: 'alert-dead-letter',
  deadLetterRetry: 'alert.dead-letter-retry',
  decide: 'alert.decide',
  escalate: 'alert.escalate',
  correlate: 'alert.correlate',
  digest: 'notification.digest',
  evaluateFast: 'alert.evaluate.fast',
  evaluateWindow: 'alert.evaluate.window',
  evaluateOperational: 'alert.evaluate.operational',
  evaluateAi: 'alert.evaluate.ai',
  notificationRouter: 'alert.notification-router',
  telemetryOutboxRelay: 'alert.telemetry-outbox-relay',
  errorGroupRegressed: 'alert.error-group-regressed',
} as const;

const BATCH_SIZE = 100;

export interface AlertingWorkerConfig {
  teamSize?: number;
  teamConcurrency?: number;
  formIntervalSeconds?: number;
  autoResolveIntervalSeconds?: number;
  maxBatchesPerFormRun?: number;
  /** Events/batches stuck in 'processing' longer than this are requeued/failed. */
  stuckThresholdMinutes?: number;
  /** Max events claimed per escalation/auto-resolve sweep. */
  sweepClaimLimit?: number;
  /** Retention windows for the daily cleanup job. */
  retentionResolvedEventsDays?: number;
  retentionBatchesDays?: number;
  retentionDeliveryAttemptsDays?: number;
  retentionDeadLettersDays?: number;
  /** Max automatic re-drives of a dead letter before it is exhausted. */
  deadLetterMaxRetries?: number;
}

const DEFAULTS: Required<AlertingWorkerConfig> = {
  teamSize: 5,
  teamConcurrency: 3,
  formIntervalSeconds: 30,
  autoResolveIntervalSeconds: 60,
  maxBatchesPerFormRun: 20,
  stuckThresholdMinutes: 15,
  sweepClaimLimit: 200,
  retentionResolvedEventsDays: 30,
  retentionBatchesDays: 14,
  retentionDeliveryAttemptsDays: 30,
  retentionDeadLettersDays: 30,
  deadLetterMaxRetries: 3,
};

/** Minimal shape we rely on from a pg-boss job (avoids version-specific types). */
interface MinimalJob<T> { id: string; data: T }

function firstJob<T>(arg: unknown): MinimalJob<T> | null {
  if (Array.isArray(arg)) return (arg[0] as MinimalJob<T>) ?? null;
  return (arg as MinimalJob<T>) ?? null;
}

function allJobs<T>(arg: unknown): Array<MinimalJob<T>> {
  if (Array.isArray(arg)) return arg as Array<MinimalJob<T>>;
  return arg ? [arg as MinimalJob<T>] : [];
}

/**
 * Register all alerting pg-boss workers + schedules. Idempotent per process.
 * Returns a stop() that cancels schedules.
 */
/**
 * @param telemetryPool Pool that owns the `events_*` telemetry tables (the Log DB pool).
 *   Injected by the worker bootstrap per ADR-0006 / DEV-002 so this module never imports the
 *   Log DB singleton itself. Omit it and the evaluators fall back to the control-plane pool,
 *   which is correct for single-database deployments.
 */
export async function registerAlertingWorkers(
  logger: FastifyBaseLogger,
  config: AlertingWorkerConfig = {},
  projectSubscriptionResolver?: ProjectSubscriptionResolver,
  telemetryPool?: Pool,
): Promise<{ stop: () => Promise<void> }> {
  const cfg = { ...DEFAULTS, ...config };
  const log = logger.child({ component: 'alerting-workers' });

  const alertRepo = new AlertingRepository();
  const connectorRepo = new ConnectorRepository();
  const enqueueConnectorJob = async (queue: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, options?: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    pgboss.send(queue, data, options as never);
  const processor = new AlertBatchProcessor(alertRepo, connectorRepo, enqueueConnectorJob, logger, projectSubscriptionResolver);
  const escalationSweep = new AlertEscalationSweep(alertRepo, connectorRepo, enqueueConnectorJob, logger);
  // ── Queue creation with enterprise defaults ─────────────────────────────
  // process-batch: retries with backoff, then dead-letters to `alert-dead-letter`.
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.formBatches);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.processBatch, {
    retryLimit: 3,
    retryDelay: 60,
    retryBackoff: true,
    expireInSeconds: 7200,
    deadLetter: ALERT_JOBS.deadLetter,
  });
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.escalationSweep);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.autoResolve);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.orphanSweep);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.cleanup);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.deadLetter);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.deadLetterRetry);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.decide, {
    retryLimit: 5,
    retryDelay: 1,
    retryBackoff: true,
    expireInSeconds: 300,
  });
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.escalate);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.correlate);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.digest);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateFast);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateWindow);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateOperational);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateAi);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.notificationRouter);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.telemetryOutboxRelay);
  await safeCreateQueue(ALERT_JOBS.errorGroupRegressed, {
    retryLimit: 3,
    retryDelay: 1,
    retryBackoff: true,
    expireInSeconds: 300,
  });

  const runtimePool = telemetryPool ?? pool;
  const runtimeEngines = new AlertRuntimeEngines(logger, runtimePool, pool);
  const notificationRouter = new AlertNotificationRouter(runtimePool, logger);
  const telemetryOutboxRelay = new TelemetryOutboxRelay(runtimePool, logger);
  const decisionEngine = new AlertDecisionEngine(runtimePool, logger);
  const snapshotEscalation = new SnapshotEscalationWorker(logger);

  // ── process-batch: the high-throughput worker ──────────────────────────
  // pg-boss v12 concurrency options: `localConcurrency` = number of workers
  // polling/processing independently, `batchSize` = jobs fetched per poll.
  // The WorkHandler always receives an ARRAY of jobs in v12.
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.processBatch,
    { localConcurrency: cfg.teamConcurrency, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<BatchJobData>(arg);
      // Each delivered job is independent; process concurrently (no sequential await loop).
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) => processor.processBatch(job.data)));
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── form-batches: claim pending → enqueue process-batch jobs ────────────
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.formBatches,
    {} as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const job = firstJob<{ organizationId?: string }>(arg);
      await formBatches(alertRepo, log, cfg.maxBatchesPerFormRun, job?.data?.organizationId);
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── escalation-sweep: advance due escalations + resume expired acks ─────
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.escalationSweep,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      await escalationSweep.run(cfg.sweepClaimLimit);
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── auto-resolve: resolve stale firing alerts ──────────────────────────
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.autoResolve,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      const stale = await alertRepo.claimAutoResolvable(cfg.sweepClaimLimit);
      // Resolve concurrently — no sequential async loop.
      await mapBounded(stale, 10, async (event) => {
        await alertRepo.resolveEvent(event.organization_id, event.id, null, 'auto_resolved', true);
        await alertRepo.insertHistory({
          eventId: event.id, organizationId: event.organization_id,
          action: 'auto_resolved', actorId: null, actorType: 'worker',
        });
      });
      if (stale.length > 0) log.info({ resolved: stale.length }, 'Auto-resolved stale alerts');
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── orphan-sweep: recover events/batches stuck in 'processing' ─────────
  // Covers worker crashes and job expiry: events return to 'pending' (the form
  // worker re-batches them) and stale batches are marked failed.
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.orphanSweep,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      const requeued = await alertRepo.requeueStuckProcessingEvents(cfg.stuckThresholdMinutes, cfg.sweepClaimLimit);
      const failedBatches = await alertRepo.failStaleBatches(cfg.stuckThresholdMinutes);
      if (requeued.length > 0 || failedBatches > 0) {
        await mapBounded(requeued, 10, async (event) => {
          await alertRepo.insertHistory({
            eventId: event.id, organizationId: event.organization_id,
            action: 'requeued', actorId: null, actorType: 'worker',
            metadata: { reason: 'stuck_processing', stuckThresholdMinutes: cfg.stuckThresholdMinutes },
          });
        });
        log.warn({ requeued: requeued.length, failedBatches }, 'Orphan sweep recovered stuck alerts');
      }
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── dead-letter intake: persist exhausted process-batch jobs ────────────
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.deadLetter,
    {} as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<BatchJobData>(arg);
      await Promise.allSettled(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const { batchId, organizationId } = job.data;
        const loaded = await alertRepo.getBatchWithEvents(batchId, organizationId).catch(() => null);
        await alertRepo.insertDeadLetter({
          organizationId,
          sourceQueue: ALERT_JOBS.processBatch,
          pgBossJobId: job.id,
          batchId,
          eventIds: loaded ? loaded.events.map((e) => e.id) : [],
          jobPayload: job.data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
          errorMessage: 'process-batch job exhausted retries',
          maxRetries: cfg.deadLetterMaxRetries,
        });
        if (loaded) {
          await mapBounded(loaded.events, 10, async (event) => {
            await alertRepo.insertHistory({
              eventId: event.id, organizationId,
              action: 'dead_lettered', actorId: null, actorType: 'worker',
              metadata: { batchId, pgBossJobId: job.id },
            });
          });
        }
        log.error({ batchId, organizationId, jobId: job.id }, 'process-batch job dead-lettered');
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── dead-letter-retry: re-drive retryable dead letters ──────────────────
  // Only re-sends when the batch is still in 'processing' (not yet recovered
  // by the orphan sweeper); otherwise the automatic recovery already covers it.
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.deadLetterRetry,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      const deadLetters = await alertRepo.claimRetryableDeadLetters(50);
      await mapBounded(deadLetters, 5, async (deadLetter) => {
        try {
          let redrove = false;
          if (deadLetter.batch_id) {
            const loaded = await alertRepo.getBatchWithEvents(deadLetter.batch_id, deadLetter.organization_id).catch(() => null);
            if (loaded && loaded.batch.status === 'processing') {
              await pgboss.send(
                ALERT_JOBS.processBatch,
                { batchId: deadLetter.batch_id, organizationId: deadLetter.organization_id } satisfies BatchJobData,
                { retryLimit: 3, retryDelay: 60, retryBackoff: true, expireInSeconds: 7200 } as never,
              );
              redrove = true;
            }
          }
          if (redrove || deadLetter.retry_count + 1 < deadLetter.max_retries) {
            await alertRepo.markDeadLetterRetried(deadLetter.id);
          } else {
            await alertRepo.markDeadLetterExhausted(deadLetter.id);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          log.error({ err, deadLetterId: deadLetter.id }, 'Dead-letter re-drive failed');
        }
      });
      if (deadLetters.length > 0) log.info({ count: deadLetters.length }, 'Dead-letter retry sweep finished');
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── cleanup: retention purge ────────────────────────────────────────────
  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.cleanup,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      const [events, batches, attempts, deadLetters, throttles] = await Promise.all([
        alertRepo.purgeOldTerminalEvents(cfg.retentionResolvedEventsDays),
        alertRepo.purgeOldBatches(cfg.retentionBatchesDays),
        alertRepo.purgeOldDeliveryAttempts(cfg.retentionDeliveryAttemptsDays),
        alertRepo.purgeOldDeadLetters(cfg.retentionDeadLettersDays),
        alertRepo.purgeOldThrottleWindows(),
      ]);
      log.info(
        { events, batches, attempts, deadLetters, throttles },
        'Alerting retention cleanup finished',
      );
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.decide,
    { localConcurrency: 8, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<AlertDecisionCandidate>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const result = await decisionEngine.decide({
          ...job.data,
          observedAt: new Date(job.data.observedAt),
        });
        await Promise.all(result.notificationJobs.map((notificationJob) =>
          pgboss.send(ALERT_JOBS.notificationRouter, { notificationJobId: notificationJob.id }, {
            retryLimit: 3,
            retryDelay: 1,
            retryBackoff: true,
            expireInSeconds: 300,
          } as never),
        ));
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.escalate,
    { localConcurrency: 4, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      if (!env.ESCALATION_V2) return;
      const jobs = allJobs<Parameters<SnapshotEscalationWorker['run']>[0]>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) => snapshotEscalation.run(job.data)));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.correlate,
    { localConcurrency: 2, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async () => undefined) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.digest,
    { localConcurrency: 2, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async () => undefined) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.evaluateFast,
    { localConcurrency: 8, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<FastEvaluationInput>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) => runtimeEngines.evaluateFast(job.data)));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.evaluateWindow,
    { localConcurrency: 4, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<{ organizationId: string }>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) =>
        runtimeEngines.evaluateTier({ organizationId: job.data.organizationId, tier: 'window' }),
      ));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.evaluateOperational,
    { localConcurrency: 3, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<{ organizationId: string }>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) =>
        runtimeEngines.evaluateTier({ organizationId: job.data.organizationId, tier: 'operational' }),
      ));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.evaluateAi,
    { localConcurrency: 2, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<{ organizationId: string }>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) =>
        runtimeEngines.evaluateTier({ organizationId: job.data.organizationId, tier: 'ai' }),
      ));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.notificationRouter,
    { localConcurrency: 5, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<{ notificationJobId?: string }>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map((job) =>
        job.data.notificationJobId
          ? notificationRouter.dispatchById(job.data.notificationJobId)
          : notificationRouter.run(100),
      ));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.telemetryOutboxRelay,
    { localConcurrency: 2, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async () => {
      await telemetryOutboxRelay.run(250);
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    ALERT_JOBS.errorGroupRegressed,
    { localConcurrency: 4, batchSize: 1 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<Record<string, unknown>>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const payload = job.data;
        await runtimeEngines.evaluateFast({
          organizationId: String(payload.organizationId ?? ''),
          projectId: String(payload.projectId ?? ''),
          environment: typeof payload.environment === 'string' ? payload.environment : null,
          events: [{
            type: 'error',
            eventId: String(payload.eventId ?? ''),
            message: String(payload.eventType ?? 'ErrorGroupRegressed'),
            severity: String(payload.severity ?? 'error'),
            fingerprint: String(payload.fingerprint ?? ''),
          }],
        } as never);
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  // ── Schedules (cron) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // pg-boss cron is minute-granularity; sub-minute cadence is approximated by
  // the form worker re-claiming whatever is pending each run.
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.formBatches, '* * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-form-batches' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.escalationSweep, '* * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-escalation-sweep' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.autoResolve, '* * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-auto-resolve' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.orphanSweep, '*/5 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-orphan-sweep' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.deadLetterRetry, '*/5 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-dead-letter-retry' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.cleanup, '17 3 * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-cleanup' } as never);
  if (env.ESCALATION_V2) {
    await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.correlate, '*/1 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'alert-correlate' } as never);
    await pgboss.schedule(ALERT_JOBS.digest, '*/1 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'notification-digest' } as never);
  }
  const runtimeTimers = startRuntimeDispatchTimers(runtimePool, log);

  log.info({ ...cfg }, 'Alerting workers registered');

  return {
    stop: async () => {
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.formBatches).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.escalationSweep).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.autoResolve).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.orphanSweep).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.deadLetterRetry).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(ALERT_JOBS.cleanup).catch(() => undefined);
      for (const timer of runtimeTimers) clearInterval(timer);
    },
  };
}

function startRuntimeDispatchTimers(telemetryPool: Pool, log: FastifyBaseLogger): NodeJS.Timeout[] {
  const dispatch = async (
    queue: typeof ALERT_JOBS.evaluateWindow | typeof ALERT_JOBS.evaluateOperational | typeof ALERT_JOBS.evaluateAi,
    cadenceSeconds: number,
  ): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      const orgs = await activeRuntimeOrganizations(telemetryPool);
      const bucket = Math.floor(Date.now() / (cadenceSeconds * 1000));
      await Promise.allSettled(orgs.map((organizationId) =>
        pgboss.send(
          queue,
          { organizationId },
          {
            singletonKey: `${queue}:${organizationId}:${bucket}`,
            expireInSeconds: Math.max(60, cadenceSeconds * 4),
            retryLimit: 2,
            retryDelay: 5,
            retryBackoff: true,
          } as never,
        ),
      ));
      if (orgs.length > 0) log.debug({ queue, orgs: orgs.length }, 'Runtime alert evaluation jobs dispatched');
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn({ err, queue }, 'Runtime alert evaluation dispatch failed');
    }
  };

  const timers = [
    setInterval(() => void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateWindow, 5), 5_000),
    setInterval(() => void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateOperational, 30), 30_000),
    setInterval(() => void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateAi, 300), 300_000),
    setInterval(() => void pgboss.send(ALERT_JOBS.notificationRouter, {}, {
      singletonKey: `alert-notification-router:${Math.floor(Date.now() / 10_000)}`,
      expireInSeconds: 60,
    } as never).catch(() => undefined), 10_000),
    setInterval(() => void pgboss.send(ALERT_JOBS.telemetryOutboxRelay, {}, {
      singletonKey: `alert-telemetry-outbox:${Math.floor(Date.now() / 1_000)}`,
      expireInSeconds: 30,
    } as never).catch(() => undefined), 1_000),
  ];
  for (const timer of timers) timer.unref();

  void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateWindow, 5);
  void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateOperational, 30);
  void dispatch(ALERT_JOBS.evaluateAi, 300);
  return timers;
}

async function activeRuntimeOrganizations(telemetryPool: Pool): Promise<string[]> {
  const result = await telemetryPool.query<{ organization_id: string }>(
    `SELECT DISTINCT organization_id
       FROM (
         SELECT organization_id FROM events_requests WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
         UNION
         SELECT organization_id FROM events_errors WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
         UNION
         SELECT organization_id FROM events_logs WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
         UNION
         SELECT organization_id FROM events_cron_checkins WHERE ingested_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
         UNION
         SELECT organization_id FROM ai_requests WHERE updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
       ) recent
      LIMIT 1000`,
  );
  return result.rows.map((row) => row.organization_id);
}

async function safeCreateQueue(name: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
  const boss = pgboss as unknown as { createQueue?: (n: string, o?: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void> };
  if (typeof boss.createQueue === 'function') {
    await boss.createQueue(name, options).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

/**
 * Claim pending events (in batches of 100) for orgs that have any, and enqueue
 * a process-batch job per batch. Bounded by `maxBatches` per run to avoid
 * starving other queues. The pg-boss job id is recorded on the batch for
 * dead-letter traceability.
 */
async function formBatches(
  alertRepo: AlertingRepository,
  log: FastifyBaseLogger,
  maxBatches: number,
  onlyOrgId?: string,
): Promise<number> {
  const orgIds = onlyOrgId ? [onlyOrgId] : await alertRepo.findOrgsWithPendingEvents(maxBatches);
  if (orgIds.length === 0) return 0;

  let formed = 0;
  const perOrgCap = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBatches / orgIds.length)); // fair share
  await Promise.all(orgIds.map(async (orgId) => {
    const workerId = `former-${process.pid}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < perOrgCap; i++) {
      const batch = await alertRepo.createBatchFromPending(orgId, BATCH_SIZE, workerId);
      if (!batch) break; // org drained
      const jobId = await pgboss.send(ALERT_JOBS.processBatch,
        { batchId: batch.id, organizationId: orgId } satisfies BatchJobData,
        { retryLimit: 3, retryDelay: 60, retryBackoff: true, expireInSeconds: 7200 } as never);
      await alertRepo.setBatchJobId(batch.id, typeof jobId === 'string' ? jobId : null);
      formed += 1;
    }
  }));

  if (formed > 0) log.info({ formed }, 'Formed and enqueued alert batches');
  return formed;
}

async function mapBounded<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<PromiseSettledResult<R>[]> {
  const results: PromiseSettledResult<R>[] = new Array(items.length);
  let cursor = 0;
  const lane = async (): Promise<void> => {
    while (cursor < items.length) {
      const i = cursor++;
      const item = items[i]!;
      try { results[i] = { status: 'fulfilled', value: await fn(item) }; }
      catch (reason) { results[i] = { status: 'rejected', reason }; }
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, lane));
  return results;
}

import type { FastifyBaseLogger } from 'fastify';
import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import { pgboss } from '../../../lib/pgboss.js';
import { env } from '../../../config/env.js';
import { sendEmail } from '../../../shared/email/mailer.js';
import { CONNECTOR_JOBS, CONNECTOR_PRIORITY, type ConnectorJobName } from '../../connectors/job.constants.js';
import {
  AlertRuntimeRepository,
  type NotificationJobDetailRow,
  type NotificationJobStatus,
} from './alert-runtime.repository.js';
import type { ConnectorTransportJob } from '../../connectors/delivery/transport.types.js';

export interface NotificationRouterSummary {
  claimed: number;
  sent: number;
  queued: number;
  failed: number;
  suppressed: number;
}

export class AlertNotificationRouter {
  private readonly repo: AlertRuntimeRepository;
  private readonly log: FastifyBaseLogger;

  constructor(
    logDb: Pool,
    logger: FastifyBaseLogger,
  ) {
    this.repo = new AlertRuntimeRepository(logDb);
    this.log = logger.child({ component: 'alert-notification-router' });
  }

  async run(limit = 100): Promise<NotificationRouterSummary> {
    const jobs = await this.repo.withTransaction((client) => this.repo.claimDueNotificationJobs(limit, client));
    const summary: NotificationRouterSummary = {
      claimed: jobs.length,
      sent: 0,
      queued: 0,
      failed: 0,
      suppressed: 0,
    };
    await Promise.allSettled(jobs.map(async (job) => {
      const status = await this.dispatch(job);
      if (status === 'sent') summary.sent += 1;
      else if (status === 'queued') summary.queued += 1;
      else if (status === 'suppressed') summary.suppressed += 1;
      else if (status === 'failed') summary.failed += 1;
    }));
    if (jobs.length > 0) this.log.info({ ...summary }, 'Alert notification router run finished');
    return summary;
  }

  async dispatchById(notificationJobId: string): Promise<NotificationJobStatus> {
    const job = await this.repo.findNotificationJobById(notificationJobId);
    if (!job) return 'failed';
    if (job.status !== 'pending' && job.status !== 'queued') return job.status;
    return this.dispatch(job);
  }

  private async dispatch(job: NotificationJobDetailRow): Promise<NotificationJobStatus> {
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    try {
      if (job.channel_kind === 'in_app') {
        await this.mark(job, 'sent', startedAt);
        return 'sent';
      }

      if (job.channel_kind === 'email' && !job.connector_id && job.recipient_ref) {
        await this.sendDirectEmail(job);
        await this.mark(job, 'sent', startedAt);
        return 'sent';
      }

      if (!job.connector_id) {
        await this.mark(job, 'suppressed', startedAt, 'missing_connector');
        return 'suppressed';
      }

      const queueName = env.ALERTING_V2_READ
        ? `connector.v2.${job.channel_kind}`
        : `${CONNECTOR_JOBS.send}-${job.channel_kind}` as ConnectorJobName;
      const transport: ConnectorTransportJob = {
        organizationId: job.organization_id,
        notificationJobId: job.id,
        connectorId: job.connector_id,
        channelKind: job.channel_kind,
        severity: toConnectorSeverity(job.severity),
        idempotencyKey: job.idempotency_key,
        correlationId: job.alert_key,
        payload: job.payload,
      };
      await pgboss.send(
        queueName,
        env.ALERTING_V2_READ
          ? transport
          : {
              organizationId: job.organization_id,
              connectorId: job.connector_id,
              payload: job.payload,
              routeId: job.route_id,
            },
        {
          priority: CONNECTOR_PRIORITY[toConnectorSeverity(job.severity)] ?? job.priority,
          retryLimit: 0,
          retryDelay: 60,
          retryBackoff: true,
          expireInSeconds: env.CONNECTOR_SEND_EXPIRE_SECONDS,
        } as never,
      );
      await this.mark(job, 'queued', startedAt);
      return 'queued';
    } catch (err) {
      await this.mark(job, 'failed', startedAt, err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
      this.log.error({ err, notificationJobId: job.id }, 'Alert notification dispatch failed');
      return 'failed';
    }
  }

  private async sendDirectEmail(job: NotificationJobDetailRow): Promise<void> {
    const payload = job.payload as {
      title?: unknown;
      body?: unknown;
      severity?: unknown;
    };
    const title = typeof payload.title === 'string' ? payload.title : 'Alert notification';
    const body = typeof payload.body === 'string' ? payload.body : title;
    await sendEmail({
      to: job.recipient_ref!,
      subject: `[${String(payload.severity ?? job.severity).toUpperCase()}] ${title}`,
      text: `${title}\n\n${body}`,
      html: `<!doctype html><html><body><h2>${escapeHtml(title)}</h2><p>${escapeHtml(body).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p></body></html>`,
    });
  }

  private async mark(
    job: NotificationJobDetailRow,
    status: NotificationJobStatus,
    startedAt: number,
    errorMessage?: string,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await this.repo.setNotificationJobStatus(job.id, status);
    await this.repo.appendDeliveryAttempts([{
      organizationId: job.organization_id,
      projectId: job.project_id,
      alertEventId: job.alert_event_id,
      notificationJobId: job.id,
      channelKind: job.channel_kind,
      connectorId: job.connector_id,
      routeId: job.route_id,
      recipientUserId: job.recipient_user_id,
      attemptNumber: 1,
      status,
      errorCategory: errorMessage ? 'router' : null,
      errorMessage: errorMessage ?? null,
      latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
    }]);
  }
}

function toConnectorSeverity(severity: string): 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'critical' {
  if (severity === 'critical' || severity === 'fatal') return 'critical';
  if (severity === 'error') return 'error';
  if (severity === 'warning') return 'warning';
  return 'info';
}

function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

import type { Pool } from 'pg';

export type AlertRuntimeTier = 'fast' | 'window' | 'operational' | 'ai';

const RULE_COLUMNS = `

  threshold_overrides, action_mode, requested_channels, recipient_overrides,

const TIER_FIELD_PREFIXES: Record<AlertRuntimeTier, string[]> = {
  fast: [

    'requests.latency.p99',
    'latency.p99',
    'availability.pct',

    'trend.regression',
  ],
};

export function tierForFieldPath(fieldPath: string): AlertRuntimeTier | null {
  const normalized = fieldPath.trim().toLowerCase();
  for (const [tier, prefixes] of Object.entries(TIER_FIELD_PREFIXES) as Array<[AlertRuntimeTier, string[]]>) {
    if (prefixes.some((prefix) => normalized === prefix || normalized.startsWith(`${prefix}.`))) {
      return tier;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export class AlertRuntimeRuleCatalog {
  constructor(private readonly db: Pool) {}

  async listRulesForTier(organizationId: string, tier: AlertRuntimeTier): Promise<RuntimeRuleRow[]> {
    const prefixes = TIER_FIELD_PREFIXES[tier];
    const result = await this.db.query<RuntimeRuleRow>(
      `SELECT ${RULE_COLUMNS}
         FROM alert_rules r
        WHERE r.organization_id = $1
          AND r.enabled = TRUE
          AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM alert_rule_conditions c
             WHERE c.rule_id = r.id
               AND EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM unnest($2::text[]) AS p(prefix)
                  WHERE lower(c.field_path) = p.prefix
                     OR lower(c.field_path) LIKE p.prefix || '.%'
               )
          )
        ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
        LIMIT 1000`,
      [organizationId, prefixes],
    );
    return result.rows;
  }

  async listConditions(ruleIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, AlertRuleConditionRow[]>> {
    const grouped = new Map<string, AlertRuleConditionRow[]>();
    if (ruleIds.length === 0) return grouped;
    const result = await this.db.query<AlertRuleConditionRow>(
      `SELECT *
         FROM alert_rule_conditions
        WHERE rule_id = ANY($1::uuid[])
        ORDER BY rule_id, order_index ASC, id ASC`,
      [ruleIds],
    );
    for (const row of result.rows) {
      const list = grouped.get(row.rule_id) ?? [];
      list.push(row);
      grouped.set(row.rule_id, list);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  async listBindings(organizationId: string, ruleIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, AlertRuleBindingRow[]>> {
    const grouped = new Map<string, AlertRuleBindingRow[]>();
    if (ruleIds.length === 0) return grouped;
    const result = await this.db.query<AlertRuleBindingRow>(
      `SELECT ${BINDING_COLUMNS}
         FROM alert_rule_bindings
        WHERE organization_id = $1
          AND rule_id = ANY($2::uuid[])
          AND deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY rule_id, scope_level ASC, priority DESC, created_at ASC`,
      [organizationId, ruleIds],
    );
    for (const row of result.rows) {
      const list = grouped.get(row.rule_id) ?? [];
      list.push(row);
      grouped.set(row.rule_id, list);
    }
    return grouped;
  }

  async resolveRulesForScope(
    organizationId: string,
    tier: AlertRuntimeTier,
    scope: EvaluationScope,
  ): Promise<ResolvedRuntimeRule[]> {
    const rules = await this.listRulesForTier(organizationId, tier);
    const ruleIds = rules.map((rule) => rule.id);
    const [conditionsByRule, bindingsByRule] = await Promise.all([
      this.listConditions(ruleIds),
      this.listBindings(organizationId, ruleIds),
    ]);

    return rules.map((rule) => ({
      rule,
      effective: resolveEffectiveRule(
        rule,
        conditionsByRule.get(rule.id) ?? [],
        bindingsByRule.get(rule.id) ?? [],
        scope,
      ),
    }));
  }
}

// File: src\modules\connectors\delivery\delivery.service.ts (typescript)
/**
 * Notification dispatcher.
 *
 * Responsible for actually delivering a {@link NotificationPayload} through a
 * connector while enforcing the reliability envelope:
 *   - per-connector rate limiting
 *   - circuit breaker around the external API
 *   - delivery record bookkeeping (connector_deliveries)
 *   - retry scheduling with exponential backoff + jitter
 *   - dead-letter on exhausted/non-retryable failures
 *
 * The dispatcher is transport-agnostic: a foreground call (test send) and the
 * background retry worker both funnel through `attemptDelivery`.
 */
import type { FastifyBaseLogger } from 'fastify';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { pgboss } from '../../../lib/pgboss.js';
import { ConnectorRepository } from '../repository.js';
import { createConnector } from '../registry.js';
import { decryptConfigAsync } from '../secrets/secret.service.js';
import { computeBackoffMs } from '../runtime.js';
import type { BaseConnector } from '../shared/base.connector.js';
import {
  type ConnectorConfigRow,
  type ConnectorContext,
  type DeliveryResult,
  type DeliveryRow,
  type FailureCategory,
  type NotificationPayload,
} from '../types.js';

export interface DispatchOutcome {
  deliveryId: string;
  status: DeliveryRow['status'];
  result: DeliveryResult;
}

export class NotificationDispatcher {
  constructor(
    private readonly repository: ConnectorRepository,
    private readonly logger: FastifyBaseLogger,
    private readonly emitEvent: (event: string, payload: any) => void = () => {},
  ) {}

  /** Build a live connector instance from a stored config row. */
  async instantiate(row: ConnectorConfigRow): Promise<BaseConnector> {
    const config = await decryptConfigAsync(row.encrypted_config);
    const ctx: ConnectorContext = {
      id: row.id,
      name: row.name,
      organizationId: row.organization_id,
      config,
      rateLimit: { requests: row.rate_limit_requests, windowSeconds: row.rate_limit_window_seconds },
      log: this.logger.child({ connectorId: row.id, connectorType: row.type }),
    };
    return createConnector(row.type, ctx);
  }

  /**
   * Dispatch a notification through a connector. Creates a delivery row and
   * runs the first attempt synchronously. Returns the outcome so callers
   * (e.g. the test-send endpoint) can surface immediate results.
   */
  async dispatch(
    row: ConnectorConfigRow,
    payload: NotificationPayload,
    opts: { routeId?: string | null } = {},
  ): Promise<DispatchOutcome> {
    // BUG-09: Deduplication / suppression window
    if (payload.dedupKey) {
      const recent = await this.repository.findDeliveryByDedupKey(row.id, payload.dedupKey, 5);
      if (recent) {
        this.logger.info({ dedupKey: payload.dedupKey }, 'Delivery suppressed due to recent identical payload');
        const suppressed = await this.repository.insertDelivery({
          organizationId: row.organization_id,
          connectorId: row.id,
          routeId: opts.routeId ?? null,
          notificationType: payload.notificationType,
          severity: payload.severity,
          payload: this.payloadForStorage(payload),
          maxAttempts: 1,
          correlationId: payload.correlationId,
          parentDeliveryId: null,
          status: 'suppressed' as any,
        });
        return {
          deliveryId: suppressed.id,
          status: 'suppressed' as any,
          result: { success: true, latencyMs: 0 },
        };
      }
    }

    // BUG-03: Idempotent dispatch
    const { row: delivery, existed } = await this.repository.insertDeliveryIdempotent({
      organizationId: row.organization_id,
      connectorId: row.id,
      routeId: opts.routeId ?? null,
      notificationType: payload.notificationType,
      severity: payload.severity,
      payload: this.payloadForStorage(payload),
      maxAttempts: row.max_retries + 1,
      correlationId: payload.correlationId,
      parentDeliveryId: null,
      status: 'pending',
    });

    if (existed && delivery.status === 'sent') {
      return { deliveryId: delivery.id, status: 'sent', result: { success: true, latencyMs: 0 } };
    }

    return this.attemptDelivery(row, delivery, payload, existed ? delivery.attempts : 0);
  }

  /** Process a single retry (invoked by the background worker). */
  async processRetry(row: ConnectorConfigRow, delivery: DeliveryRow): Promise<DispatchOutcome> {
    const payload = this.payloadFromStorage(delivery);
    return this.attemptDelivery(row, delivery, payload, delivery.attempts);
  }

  private async attemptDelivery(
    row: ConnectorConfigRow,
    delivery: DeliveryRow,
    payload: NotificationPayload,
    priorAttempts: number,
  ): Promise<DispatchOutcome> {
    const log = this.logger.child({ connectorId: row.id, deliveryId: delivery.id, correlationId: payload.correlationId });

    // 1. Rate limit
    const rate = await this.repository.consumeRateLimitToken(
      row.id,
      row.rate_limit_requests,
      row.rate_limit_window_seconds,
    );
    if (!rate.allowed) {
      return this.scheduleRetryOrFail(
        row, delivery, payload, priorAttempts,
        'rate_limit', 'Global rate limit exceeded', true, rate.retryAfterMs, log,
      );
    }

    const CIRCUIT_RESET_MS = 30_000;
    const circuitAllowed = await this.repository.circuitAllows(row.id, CIRCUIT_RESET_MS);
    if (!circuitAllowed) {
      log.warn('Circuit open — short-circuiting delivery');
      return this.scheduleRetryOrFail(
        row, delivery, payload, priorAttempts,
        'circuit_open', 'Circuit breaker open', true, undefined, log,
      );
    }

    // 3. Deliver
    let result: DeliveryResult;
    try {
      const connector = await this.instantiate(row);
      result = await connector.send(payload);
    } catch (err) {
      result = {
        success: false,
        errorMessage: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Connector instantiation failed',
        failureCategory: 'invalid_config',
        retryable: false,
        latencyMs: 0,
      };
    }

    if (result.success) {
      await this.repository.markDeliverySent(delivery.id, {
        externalMessageId: result.externalMessageId ?? null,
        responseStatusCode: result.statusCode ?? null,
        responseBody: result.responseBody ?? null,
        latencyMs: result.latencyMs,
      });
      await this.repository.recordSuccess(row.id);
      await this.recordUsage(row, payload, log);
      await this.repository.insertAuditLog({
        organizationId: row.organization_id,
        connectorId: row.id,
        action: 'delivery.sent',
        actorId: null,
        changesSummary: {
          deliveryId: delivery.id,
          statusCode: result.statusCode ?? null,
          latencyMs: result.latencyMs,
          externalMessageId: result.externalMessageId ?? null,
        },
      });
      await this.repository.recordCircuitSuccess(row.id);
      log.info({ latencyMs: result.latencyMs }, 'Notification delivered');
      return { deliveryId: delivery.id, status: 'sent', result };
    }

    // Failure path
    const circuitState = await this.repository.recordCircuitFailure(row.id, row.failure_threshold);
    await this.repository.recordFailure(row.id);
    if (circuitState === 'open') {
      await this.enqueueConnectorFailureAlert(row, delivery.id, result.errorMessage ?? 'Delivery failed', log);
    }

    return this.scheduleRetryOrFail(
      row, delivery, payload, priorAttempts,
      result.failureCategory ?? 'unknown',
      result.errorMessage ?? 'Delivery failed',
      result.retryable ?? false,
      undefined,
      log,
    );
  }

  private async enqueueConnectorFailureAlert(
    row: ConnectorConfigRow,
    deliveryId: string,
    errorMessage: string,
    log: FastifyBaseLogger,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await pgboss.send(
        'alert.evaluate.fast',
        {
          organizationId: row.organization_id,
          projectId: row.project_id,
          signals: [{
            projectId: row.project_id,
            source: 'connector',
            kind: 'open_circuit',
            labels: { connector_id: row.id, connector_type: row.type },
            evidence: {
              connectorId: row.id,
              connectorType: row.type,
              deliveryId,
              errorMessage,
            },
          }],
        },
        {
          singletonKey: `connector-open-circuit:${row.id}:${Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000)}`,
          expireInSeconds: 60,
          retryLimit: 1,
          retryDelay: 5,
        } as never,
      );
    } catch (err) {
      log.warn({ err, connectorId: row.id }, 'Failed to enqueue connector open-circuit alert');
    }
  }

  private async scheduleRetryOrFail(
    row: ConnectorConfigRow,
    delivery: DeliveryRow,
    payload: NotificationPayload,
    priorAttempts: number,
    category: FailureCategory,
    message: string,
    retryable: boolean,
    explicitDelayMs: number | undefined,
    log: FastifyBaseLogger,
  ): Promise<DispatchOutcome> {
    const attemptsSoFar = priorAttempts + 1;
    const maxAttempts = row.max_retries + 1;
    const canRetry = retryable && attemptsSoFar < maxAttempts;

    if (canRetry) {
      const delayMs = explicitDelayMs ?? computeBackoffMs(
        attemptsSoFar,
        row.retry_backoff_base_ms,
        Number(row.retry_backoff_multiplier),
      );
      const nextRetryAt = new Date(Date.now() + delayMs);
      await this.repository.markDeliveryRetrying(delivery.id, nextRetryAt, message);
      await this.repository.insertAuditLog({
        organizationId: row.organization_id,
        connectorId: row.id,
        action: 'delivery.retry_scheduled',
        actorId: null,
        changesSummary: {
          deliveryId: delivery.id,
          category,
          attemptsSoFar,
          nextRetryAt: nextRetryAt.toISOString(),
        },
      });
      log.warn({ category, attemptsSoFar, delayMs, nextRetryAt }, 'Delivery failed — scheduled for retry');
      return {
        deliveryId: delivery.id,
        status: 'retrying',
        result: { success: false, errorMessage: message, failureCategory: category, retryable: true, latencyMs: 0 },
      };
    }

    // Terminal failure → mark failed + dead-letter
    await this.repository.markDeliveryFailed(delivery.id, message, { category });
    await this.repository.insertAuditLog({
      organizationId: row.organization_id,
      connectorId: row.id,
      action: 'delivery.failed',
      actorId: null,
      changesSummary: {
        deliveryId: delivery.id,
        category,
        attemptsSoFar,
        retryable,
      },
    });
    await this.repository.insertDeadLetter({
      originalDeliveryId: delivery.id,
      organizationId: row.organization_id,
      connectorId: row.id,
      failureReason: message,
      failureCategory: category,
      errorStack: null,
      originalPayload: this.payloadForStorage(payload),
      retryAttempts: attemptsSoFar,
    });
    this.emitEvent('connector.dead_letter', {
      orgId: row.organization_id,
      connectorId: row.id,
      deliveryId: delivery.id,
      category,
    });
    log.error({ category, attemptsSoFar }, 'Delivery permanently failed — moved to dead-letter');
    return {
      deliveryId: delivery.id,
      status: 'failed',
      result: { success: false, errorMessage: message, failureCategory: category, retryable: false, latencyMs: 0 },
    };
  }

  private payloadForStorage(p: NotificationPayload): Record<string, unknown> {
    // Persist the full payload so retries are self-contained. Strip undefined
    // keys so the stored JSON stays compact.
    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p)) {
      if (v !== undefined) out[k] = v;
    }
    return out;
  }

  private async recordUsage(
    row: ConnectorConfigRow,
    payload: NotificationPayload,
    log: FastifyBaseLogger,
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const projectId = typeof payload.metadata?.projectId === 'string'
        ? payload.metadata.projectId
        : typeof payload.metadata?.project_id === 'string' ? payload.metadata.project_id : null;
      await this.repository.recordSuccessfulDeliveryUsage(row.organization_id, projectId, row.type);
    } catch (err) {
      log.error({ err }, 'Connector delivery usage accounting failed');
    }
  }

  private payloadFromStorage(delivery: DeliveryRow): NotificationPayload {
    const p = delivery.payload as Partial<NotificationPayload>;
    return {
      notificationType: p.notificationType ?? delivery.notification_type,
      severity: p.severity ?? delivery.severity,
      title: p.title ?? '',
      body: p.body ?? '',
      ...(p.fields ? { fields: p.fields } : {}),
      ...(p.url ? { url: p.url } : {}),
      ...(p.threadKey ? { threadKey: p.threadKey } : {}),
      ...(p.metadata ? { metadata: p.metadata } : {}),
      correlationId: p.correlationId ?? delivery.correlation_id,
      ...(p.dedupKey ? { dedupKey: p.dedupKey } : {}),
    };
  }

  /** Convenience for building a payload's correlation id when not supplied. */
  static newCorrelationId(): string {
    return randomUUID();
  }
}


// File: src\modules\connectors\queue.ts (typescript)
/**
 * Connector pg-boss queue wiring.
 *
 * Required queues:
 *   - connector-send
 *   - connector-health-check
 *   - connector-test
 *   - connector-secret-rotation
 *   - connector-oauth-refresh
 *   - connector-cleanup
 *   - connector-dead-letter-retry
 *   - connector-delivery-retry
 */
import type { FastifyBaseLogger } from 'fastify';
import { pgboss } from '../../lib/pgboss.js';
import { ConnectorRepository } from './repository.js';
import { NotificationDispatcher } from './delivery/delivery.service.js';
import { ConnectorService } from './service.js';
import { ConnectorMonitor } from './monitor.js';
import { sweepRateLimiter } from './runtime.js';
import { decryptConfig, encryptConfig } from './secrets/secret.service.js';
import { CONNECTOR_JOBS } from './job.constants.js';
import type { ConnectorConfigRow, NotificationPayload, RequestMeta } from './types.js';
import { env } from '../../config/env.js';
import { listConnectorTypes } from './registry.js';
import { workerMetrics } from './metrics/worker-metrics.js';
import { EntitlementsRepository } from '../billing/entitlements/repository.js';
import { pool } from '../../config/database.js';
import { ConnectorGlobalGuards } from './runtime-global-guards.js';
import { isConnectorTransportJob, type ConnectorTransportJob } from './delivery/transport.types.js';

interface MinimalJob<T> { id: string; data: T }

function allJobs<T>(arg: unknown): Array<MinimalJob<T>> {
  if (Array.isArray(arg)) return arg as Array<MinimalJob<T>>;
  return arg ? [arg as MinimalJob<T>] : [];
}

async function safeCreateQueue(name: string): Promise<void> {
  const boss = pgboss as unknown as { createQueue?: (n: string) => Promise<void> };
  if (typeof boss.createQueue === 'function') {
    await boss.createQueue(name).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

export interface ConnectorSendJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  connectorId: string;
  payload: NotificationPayload;
  routeId?: string | null;
  projectChannel?: {
    userId?: string;
    channelId?: string;
    channelType?: string;
    destination?: string | null;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
}

export interface ConnectorTestJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  connectorId: string;
}

export interface ConnectorSecretRotationJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  connectorId: string;
  config: Record<string, unknown>;
  actorUserId?: string | null;
}

export interface ConnectorDeliveryRetryJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  deliveryId: string;
  actorUserId?: string | null;
}

export interface ConnectorOAuthRefreshJobData {
  organizationId: string;
  connectorId: string;
}

function workerMeta(actorUserId: string | null = null): RequestMeta {
  return {
    actorUserId,
    actorIp: '127.0.0.1',
    actorUserAgent: 'connector-worker',
    requestId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000',
  };
}

function resolveCredentialExpiry(config: Record<string, unknown>, fallback: Date | null): Date | null {
  const raw = config.expiresAt;
  if (raw instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(raw.getTime())) return raw;
  if (typeof raw === 'string') {
    const parsed = new Date(raw);
    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return parsed;
  }
  return fallback;
}

function payloadWithProjectChannel(job: ConnectorSendJobData): NotificationPayload {
  if (!job.projectChannel) return job.payload;
  return {
    ...job.payload,
    metadata: {
      ...(job.payload.metadata ?? {}),
      projectChannel: {
        ...(job.projectChannel.metadata ?? {}),
        userId: job.projectChannel.userId,
        channelId: job.projectChannel.channelId,
        channelType: job.projectChannel.channelType,
        destination: job.projectChannel.destination ?? null,
      },
    },
  };
}

function hasEmailDestination(payload: NotificationPayload): boolean {
  const projectChannel = payload.metadata?.projectChannel as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
  return typeof projectChannel?.destination === 'string'
    && /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(projectChannel.destination.trim());
}

export async function registerConnectorWorkers(
  logger: FastifyBaseLogger,
): Promise<{ stop: () => Promise<void> }> {
  const log = logger.child({ component: 'connector-workers' });
  const repository = new ConnectorRepository();
  const entitlements = new EntitlementsRepository();
  const globalGuards = new ConnectorGlobalGuards(pool);
  const dispatcher = new NotificationDispatcher(repository, logger);
  const service = new ConnectorService({
    repository,
    dispatcher,
    logger,
    emitEvent: async () => undefined,
  });
  const monitor = new ConnectorMonitor(repository, dispatcher, service, logger);

  await Promise.all(Object.values(CONNECTOR_JOBS).map((queue) => safeCreateQueue(queue)));

  const connectorTypes = listConnectorTypes();
  const providerQueues = connectorTypes.map((t) => `${CONNECTOR_JOBS.send}-${t.type}`);
  const transportQueues = connectorTypes.map((t) => `connector.v2.${t.type}`);
  await Promise.all([...providerQueues, ...transportQueues].map((queue) => safeCreateQueue(queue)));

  for (const queue of transportQueues) {
    await pgboss.work(
      queue,
      { localConcurrency: env.CONNECTOR_SEND_CONCURRENCY, batchSize: env.CONNECTOR_SEND_BATCH_SIZE } as never,
      (async (arg: unknown) => {
        const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorTransportJob>(arg);
        await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
          if (!isConnectorTransportJob(job.data)) {
            log.error({ jobId: job.id }, 'Rejected connector transport job with invalid contract');
            return;
          }
          const row = await repository.findById(job.data.organizationId, job.data.connectorId);
          if (!row || row.status !== 'active') {
            log.warn({ jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId }, 'Connector transport skipped: inactive connector');
            return;
          }
          const outcome = await dispatcher.dispatch(row, job.data.payload as unknown as NotificationPayload, { routeId: null });
          if (outcome.status === 'sent') await globalGuards.recordSuccess(job.data.connectorId);
          else await globalGuards.recordFailure(job.data.connectorId, env.CONNECTOR_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD);
        }));
      }) as never,
    );
  }

  for (const queue of providerQueues) {
    await pgboss.work(
      queue,
      { 
        localConcurrency: env.CONNECTOR_SEND_CONCURRENCY, 
        batchSize: env.CONNECTOR_SEND_BATCH_SIZE 
      } as never,
      (async (arg: unknown) => {
        const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorSendJobData>(arg);
        if (jobs.length === 0) return;

        const connectorIds = Array.from(new Set(jobs.map(j => j.data.connectorId)));
        const rows = await repository.getByIds(connectorIds);
        const rowMap = new Map(rows.map(r => [r.id, r]));

        await Promise.allSettled(jobs.map(async (job) => {
          workerMetrics.recordJobStarted();
          try {
            let row: ConnectorConfigRow | null | undefined = rowMap.get(job.data.connectorId);
            const payload = payloadWithProjectChannel(job.data);
            if (!row || row.status !== 'active') {
              if (!hasEmailDestination(payload)) {
                log.warn(
                  { jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId, status: row?.status ?? null },
                  'Connector send skipped: connector unavailable and no email fallback destination is present',
                );
                workerMetrics.recordJobFailed(false);
                return;
              }
              row = await repository.findFirstActiveByType(job.data.organizationId, 'email');
              if (!row) {
                const canUseManagedFallback = await entitlements.hasFeature(
                  job.data.organizationId,
                  'alerting.managed_email_fallback',
                );
                if (!canUseManagedFallback) {
                  log.warn(
                    { jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId },
                    'Connector send skipped: managed email fallback is not entitled',
                  );
                  workerMetrics.recordJobFailed(false);
                  return;
                }
                row = await repository.getOrCreateManagedEmailConnector(job.data.organizationId);
              }
              log.warn(
                {
                  jobId: job.id,
                  requestedConnectorId: job.data.connectorId,
                  requestedConnectorStatus: rowMap.get(job.data.connectorId)?.status ?? null,
                  fallbackConnectorId: row.id,
                  managedFallback: row.metadata?.managedBy === 'pulse',
                },
                'Connector unavailable; falling back to email transport',
              );
            }
            if (env.CONNECTOR_GLOBAL_LIMITS) {
              const guard = await globalGuards.acquire(job.data.connectorId, {
                limit: env.CONNECTOR_GLOBAL_LIMIT,
                windowSeconds: env.CONNECTOR_GLOBAL_WINDOW_SECONDS,
                failureThreshold: env.CONNECTOR_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD,
                resetSeconds: env.CONNECTOR_CIRCUIT_RESET_SECONDS,
              });
              if (!guard.allowed) {
                workerMetrics.recordJobFailed(true);
                log.warn({ jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId, circuitState: guard.circuitState }, 'Connector delivery denied by global guard');
                return;
              }
            }

            const outcome = await dispatcher.dispatch(row, payload, { routeId: job.data.routeId ?? null });
            if (outcome.status === 'sent') {
              if (env.CONNECTOR_GLOBAL_LIMITS) await globalGuards.recordSuccess(job.data.connectorId);
              workerMetrics.recordJobCompleted();
            } else {
              if (env.CONNECTOR_GLOBAL_LIMITS) await globalGuards.recordFailure(job.data.connectorId, env.CONNECTOR_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD);
              workerMetrics.recordJobFailed(outcome.result.retryable ?? false);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            workerMetrics.recordJobFailed(false);
            log.error({ err, jobId: job.id }, 'Connector send job errored unexpectedly');
            // no rethrow — the delivery row + DLQ is the source of truth
          }
        }));
      }) as never,
    );
  }

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.deliveryRetry,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      await monitor.processRetries();
      sweepRateLimiter();
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.healthCheck,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      await monitor.runHealthChecks();
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.test,
    { localConcurrency: 3, batchSize: 3 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorTestJobData>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const row = await repository.findById(job.data.organizationId, job.data.connectorId);
        if (!row) {
          log.warn({ jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId }, 'Connector test skipped: connector not found');
          return;
        }
        const result = await service.runConnectionTest(row, null);
        await repository.insertAuditLog({
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
          action: 'test.completed',
          actorId: null,
          changesSummary: { success: result.success },
        });
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.secretRotation,
    { localConcurrency: 2, batchSize: 2 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorSecretRotationJobData>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        await service.rotateSecret(
          job.data.organizationId,
          workerMeta(job.data.actorUserId ?? null),
          job.data.connectorId,
          { config: job.data.config },
        );
        log.info({ jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId }, 'Connector secret rotation job completed');
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.oauthRefresh,
    { localConcurrency: 3, batchSize: 3 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorOAuthRefreshJobData>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const row = await repository.findById(job.data.organizationId, job.data.connectorId);
        if (!row) {
          log.warn({ jobId: job.id, connectorId: job.data.connectorId }, 'OAuth refresh skipped: connector not found');
          return;
        }
        const credential = await repository.getCredential(job.data.organizationId, job.data.connectorId, 'oauth');
        if (!credential) {
          await repository.insertAuditLog({
            organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
            connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
            action: 'oauth.refresh_failed',
            actorId: null,
            changesSummary: { reason: 'missing_oauth_credential' },
          });
          return;
        }
        if (credential.credential_type !== 'oauth') {
          await repository.insertAuditLog({
            organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
            connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
            action: 'oauth.refresh_skipped',
            actorId: null,
            changesSummary: { reason: 'credential_not_active', credentialType: credential.credential_type },
          });
          return;
        }

        const connector = await dispatcher.instantiate(row);
        const currentCredential = decryptConfig(credential.encrypted_value);
        const refreshed = await connector.refreshCredentials(currentCredential);
        if (!refreshed.valid) {
          await repository.insertAuditLog({
            organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
            connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
            action: 'oauth.refresh_failed',
            actorId: null,
            changesSummary: { errors: refreshed.errors },
          });
          return;
        }
        if (refreshed.normalized) {
          const expiresAt = resolveCredentialExpiry(refreshed.normalized, credential.expires_at);
          await repository.upsertCredential({
            organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
            connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
            credentialType: credential.credential_type,
            keyName: credential.key_name,
            encryptedValue: encryptConfig(refreshed.normalized),
            expiresAt,
            actorUserId: null,
          });
        }
        await repository.insertAuditLog({
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          connectorId: job.data.connectorId,
          action: 'oauth.refreshed',
          actorId: null,
        });
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.cleanup,
    {} as never,
    (async () => {
      const expiredOAuthStates = await repository.cleanupExpiredOAuthStates();
      if (expiredOAuthStates > 0) {
        log.info({ expiredOAuthStates }, 'Connector cleanup removed expired OAuth states');
      }
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.work(
    CONNECTOR_JOBS.deadLetterRetry,
    { localConcurrency: 3, batchSize: 3 } as never,
    (async (arg: unknown) => {
      const jobs = allJobs<ConnectorDeliveryRetryJobData>(arg);
      await Promise.all(jobs.map(async (job) => {
        const delivery = await repository.retryDelivery(job.data.organizationId, job.data.deliveryId);
        if (!delivery) {
          log.warn({ jobId: job.id, deliveryId: job.data.deliveryId }, 'Dead-letter retry skipped: delivery not retryable');
          return;
        }
        await repository.insertAuditLog({
          organizationId: job.data.organizationId,
          connectorId: delivery.connector_id,
          action: 'delivery.dead_letter_retry_requested',
          actorId: job.data.actorUserId ?? null,
          changesSummary: { deliveryId: delivery.id },
        });
        await pgboss.send(
          CONNECTOR_JOBS.deliveryRetry,
          { organizationId: job.data.organizationId, deliveryId: delivery.id },
          { retryLimit: 3, retryDelay: 60, retryBackoff: true, expireInSeconds: env.CONNECTOR_RETRY_EXPIRE_SECONDS } as never,
        );
      }));
    }) as never,
  );

  await pgboss.schedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.deliveryRetry, '* * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'connector-delivery-retry' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.healthCheck, '*/5 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'connector-health-check' } as never);
  await pgboss.schedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.cleanup, '0 * * * *', {}, { singletonKey: 'connector-cleanup' } as never);

  log.info({ queues: CONNECTOR_JOBS }, 'Connector pg-boss workers registered');

  return {
    stop: async () => {
      await pgboss.unschedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.deliveryRetry).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.healthCheck).catch(() => undefined);
      await pgboss.unschedule(CONNECTOR_JOBS.cleanup).catch(() => undefined);
    },
  };
}


// File: src\shared\workers\main.ts (typescript)
/**
 * Worker process bootstrap (PostgreSQL queue - no BullMQ/Redis).
 *
 * Flow:
 * 1. Open a dedicated Postgres pool for background work.
 * 2. Start pg-boss background workers (alerting, billing, connectors, auth,
 *    analytics, org cleanup) plus the telemetry maintenance worker.
 * 3. Keep the process alive until SIGTERM/SIGINT, then drain + close cleanly.
 *
 * NOTE: ingestion persistence runs in the DEDICATED ingestion worker process
 * (src/shared/workers/ingestion-worker-main.ts), not here.
 *
 * Scale horizontally by running multiple copies of this process. SKIP LOCKED
 * makes that safe.
 */
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { env } from '../../config/env.js';
import { logDB } from '../../config/log-database.js';
import { logger } from '../../config/logger.js';
import { registerAlertingWorkers } from '../../modules/alerting/queue.js';
import { registerAuthAutomationWorkers } from '../../modules/auth/infrastructure/jobs/queue.js';
import { registerBillingJobWorkers } from '../../modules/billing/queue.js';
import { startConnectorMonitor } from '../../modules/connectors/workers.js';
import { registerAnalyticsWorkers } from '../../modules/event-analytics/queue.js';
import { registerOrganizationCleanupWorkers } from '../../modules/organization/shared/background/queue.js';
import { registerUserDataExportWorker } from '../../modules/user-account/queue.js';
import { registerAIWorkers } from '../../modules/ai/queue.js';
import { registerAutomationWorkers } from '../../modules/automation/workers.js';
import { startPgBoss, stopPgBoss } from '../../lib/pgboss.js';
import { AlertRuntimeRepository } from '../../modules/alerting/runtime/alert-runtime.repository.js';
import { AlertConfigRepository } from '../../modules/alerting/config/alert-config.repository.js';
import { ConnectorSubscriptionRepository } from '../../modules/projects/alerts/subscriptions/connector-subscription.repository.js';
import { AlertChannelRepository } from '../../modules/projects/alerts/channels/channel.repository.js';
import type { ProjectSubscriptionResolver } from '../../modules/alerting/batch-processor.js';
import { startAuthCleanupWorker, stopAuthCleanupWorker } from './auth-cleanup.processor.js';
import { startAuthEmailWorker, stopAuthEmailWorker } from './auth-email.processor.js';
import { startOrgEmailWorker, stopOrgEmailWorker } from './org-email.processor.js';
import { TelemetryMaintenanceWorker } from './telemetry-maintenance.processor.js';

const workerLogger = logger.child({ component: 'workers' });

async function bootstrapWorkers(): Promise<void> {
  const pgPool = new Pool({
    connectionString: env.DATABASE_URL,
    max: env.DB_POOL_MAX,
    min: env.DB_POOL_MIN,
    idleTimeoutMillis: env.DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: env.DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS,
    application_name: `pulse_background_workers_${env.NODE_ENV}`,
    keepAlive: true,
    keepAliveInitialDelayMillis: env.DB_KEEPALIVE_INITIAL_DELAY_MS,
  });

  pgPool.on('error', (err: Error) => {
    workerLogger.error({ err }, 'Unexpected worker pool error (idle connection lost)');
  });

  await pgPool.query('SELECT 1');
  await logDB.connect();

  // ── ADR-0006 pool ownership assertion ──────────────────────────────────────
  // docs/alerting-redesign/adr/0006-database-ownership.md
  //
  // Prove BEFORE any worker starts that each alerting pool is attached to the
  // database that owns its tables. Audit finding B1: the evaluator read telemetry
  // through the control-plane pool while ingestion wrote it through the Log DB pool,
  // so whenever LOG_DB_PRIMARY was a genuinely separate database, telemetry-driven
  // alerts silently never fired. This turns that into a startup crash.
  //
  // Deployment prerequisite (07-migration-plan.md §7 step 1 before step 2): the Log DB
  // alerting migrations must be applied first. Set ALERTING_RUNTIME_POOL_ASSERT=false
  // only for local bootstrap.
  await new AlertRuntimeRepository(logDB.getPrimaryPool()).assertRuntimePool(workerLogger);
  await new AlertConfigRepository().assertConfigPool(workerLogger);

  const maintenance = new TelemetryMaintenanceWorker(pgPool, workerLogger);
  maintenance.start();

  let alertingWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let analyticsWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let authAutomationWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let billingJobWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let connectorMonitor: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let orgCleanupWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let userDataExportWorker: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let aiWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;
  let automationWorkers: { stop: () => Promise<void> } | null = null;

  // Ingestion persistence moved to the dedicated ingestion worker process
  // (src/shared/workers/ingestion-worker-main.ts — pg-boss per-type queues).
  // This process no longer polls the legacy ingestion_jobs table; the legacy
  // PgQueue wiring in ./index.ts is retained on disk only for reference.
  let shuttingDown = false;
  const gracefulShutdown = async (signal: string): Promise<void> => {
    if (shuttingDown) return;
    shuttingDown = true;
    workerLogger.info({ signal }, 'Shutdown signal received — draining workers');
    maintenance.stop();
    stopAuthCleanupWorker();
    stopAuthEmailWorker();
    stopOrgEmailWorker();
    if (authAutomationWorkers) await authAutomationWorkers.stop();
    if (billingJobWorkers) await billingJobWorkers.stop();
    if (alertingWorkers) await alertingWorkers.stop();
    if (analyticsWorkers) await analyticsWorkers.stop();
    if (connectorMonitor) await connectorMonitor.stop();
    if (orgCleanupWorkers) await orgCleanupWorkers.stop();
    if (userDataExportWorker) await userDataExportWorker.stop();
    if (aiWorkers) await aiWorkers.stop();
    if (automationWorkers) await automationWorkers.stop();
    await stopPgBoss();
    await logDB.close();
    await pgPool.end();
    process.exit(0);
  };
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => void gracefulShutdown('SIGTERM'));
  process.on('SIGINT', () => void gracefulShutdown('SIGINT'));

  await startPgBoss();
  await startAuthEmailWorker();
  await startOrgEmailWorker();

  authAutomationWorkers = await registerAuthAutomationWorkers(workerLogger);
  billingJobWorkers = await registerBillingJobWorkers(workerLogger);
  connectorMonitor = await startConnectorMonitor(workerLogger);
  const connectorSubRepo = new ConnectorSubscriptionRepository();
  const alertChannelRepo = new AlertChannelRepository(pgPool);
  const projectSubscriptionResolver: ProjectSubscriptionResolver = {
    resolveByProjectId: (projectId) => connectorSubRepo.resolveAlertRoutingTargetByProjectId(projectId),
    resolveImmediateDeliveryTargets: (request) => alertChannelRepo.resolveImmediateDeliveryTargets(request),
  };
  // ADR-0006 / DEV-002: the evaluators must read `events_*` through the pool that ingestion
  // writes them with. Injected here so the alerting module never imports the Log DB singleton.
  alertingWorkers = await registerAlertingWorkers(
    workerLogger,
    {},
    projectSubscriptionResolver,
    logDB.getPrimaryPool(),
  );
  analyticsWorkers = await registerAnalyticsWorkers(workerLogger);
  userDataExportWorker = await registerUserDataExportWorker(workerLogger);
  aiWorkers = await registerAIWorkers(workerLogger);
  automationWorkers = await registerAutomationWorkers(workerLogger);

  if (process.env.ORG_CRON_ENABLED !== 'false') {
    orgCleanupWorkers = await registerOrganizationCleanupWorkers(workerLogger);
  } else {
    workerLogger.info('Organization cleanup cron disabled in worker (ORG_CRON_ENABLED=false)');
  }

  startAuthCleanupWorker();

  // PM2's wait_ready gate keeps the worker out of the healthy process set
  // until every queue consumer and scheduled job has registered successfully.
  process.send?.('ready');
  workerLogger.info('Worker process started');
  workerLogger.info('Active workers: telemetry-maintenance, auth-cleanup, auth-email, auth-automation-cron (pg-boss), org-email, org-cleanup-cron (pg-boss), connectors (pg-boss), alerting (pg-boss), billing (pg-boss), event-analytics (pg-boss), user-data-export (pg-boss), ai-reliability-analysis (pg-boss), automation (pg-boss)');
}

bootstrapWorkers().catch((error) => {
  workerLogger.fatal({ error }, 'Failed to start worker process');
  process.exit(1);
});

// File: src\modules\projects\alerts\channels\channel.repository.ts (typescript)

import { pool } from "../../../../config/database.js";

} from "./channel.types.js";
import { isAnyQuietHoursActive } from "./quiet-hours.js";

type DbClient = Pool | PoolClient;

interface ChannelRow {
  id: string;
  organization_id: string;
  project_id: string;
  connector_id: string | null;
  channel_type: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  destination: string | null;
